_doc: R3 §3a — THE REVIEWED MAPPING over contract/census.js's inventory. Ordered rules, FIRST MATCH wins; every site must match exactly one rule (unmatched = RED). A rule maps to an R-site (PLAN §3) or EXEMPTS with a reason. P0 status: PROPOSED by the executor, for advisor review before P1 — the reasons are the review surface. Server-side readers are the send-boundary payload builders (push, WhatsApp, factura, stats, Sheets); every other functions file is a writer / validator / infrastructure and is exempted as such, by file, with its count visible in census.json.
